'''Singularity ordnance''' was used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|against]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The munitions created great craters in the surface of the world, which led to the discovery of new deposits of [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]].
